paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of GPT-o4-mini on the CUBE-easy benchmark, measured by accuracy (%) across five rounds of conversation, under two feedback types: Binary and Detailed. The x-axis represents the "Round of Conversation," ranging from 1 to 5 on a linear scale. The y-axis shows "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale from 0 to 25. The "Binary" feedback type, represented by a yellow line with circular markers, starts at an accuracy of 10% in round 1 and steadily increases to 24% in round 5. The "Detailed" feedback type, shown as a blue line with circular markers, begins at 10% in round 1 and rises to 28% in round 5. Both lines show a consistent upward trend in accuracy across the rounds, with the Detailed feedback consistently outperforming the Binary feedback at each round. The caption indicates that the performance will remain at 0% on the CUBE-hard benchmark, though this is not depicted in the graph.
